history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man wearing a white t-shirt, black pants, a black Supreme baseball cap, and black sneakers with silver accents sits on a wooden bench. He is looking down at his phone, which he holds in his right hand. The background is a white brick wall covered in vibrant graffiti. The graffiti includes large, colorful lettering in pink, yellow, and blue, with some red accents and drips. Visible text on the wall reads "SWEET" and "THAN LOVE..". To the left of the man, a green graffiti design is visible. A circular, warm-toned light fixture is mounted on the wall above and to the left of the graffiti. The bench the man is sitting on is light brown wood with black trim and has graffiti on it, including a diamond shape and the word "MANN". To the right of the man, a brown corduroy jacket is draped over the bench, with a white cord and a phone resting next to it. The overall lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows. The mood is casual and urban, with a focus on street art and contemporary fashion. The color palette is dominated by the bright, contrasting colors of the graffiti against the white brick and the neutral tones of the man's clothing and the bench.
